newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT IN OPENING MATCH/TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT IN OPENING MATCH/TEAMS.

text.p: Australia won the toss and elected to bat in their opening tour match againt the Duke of Norfolk's XI on Thursday:
Duke of Norfolk's XI - Jamie Hall, Grant Flower, Tim Curtis, David Ward, Andy Flower, David Capel, Tim Walton, Andy Whittall, John Emburey (captain), Neil Radford, Neil Foster.
Australia - Mark Waugh, Mark Taylor (captain), Michael Slater, Ricky Ponting, Justin Langer, Stephen Waugh, Ian Healy, Brendon Julian, Jason Gillespie, Michael Kasprowicz, Glenn McGrath.
